{{Quote|Contrail, when we were with Shadow Squadron, at the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula, your call sign was Shadow Eleven. You flew well.''"<br />"''I had&hellip; a good teacher, sir.|Darth Vader lays the dying Contrail to rest|<ref name="Vader Adrift" />}}
'''Contrail''', designated '''CT-4981''', was an experienced [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] whose service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], lasted for over two [[Standard year/Legends|decades]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Born]] and trained as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|soldier]] for the Republic, Contrail became a member of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] and flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "'''Shadow Eleven'''" during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. During that battle, Shadow [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] aimed to take out the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|battleship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], before it could destroy the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. Despite heavy [[Death/Legends|losses]], the squadron successfully crippled the [[Warship/Legends|warship]], allowing the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to destroy it. At the end of the battle, Contrail was among the surviving members of Shadow Squadron. After the Clone Wars ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the Empire, Contrail became a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], although two years later, he was demoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] for disobeying and attacking a [[Unidentified Imperial officer (CT-4981)|superior officer]].

Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Contrail bore witness to the [[Infiltration of the Tarkin|destruction]] of the Imperial [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], which had been under construction in the planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and was [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] infiltrators. Taking a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in search of survivors, Contrail located and rescued the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in his damaged [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and brought him to Hockaleg, only to find that the local population had rebelled against the Imperial rule in the aftermath of the superweapon's destruction. As they tried to retreat to their shuttle, Contrail saved Vader's life by shielding him from enemy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire with his body. Before Contrail died, Vader&mdash;who had been known during the Clone Wars as [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Anakin Skywalker, Contrail's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]]&mdash;comforted the clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], commending his piloting skills.

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Shadow Eleven standing by.|Contrail checks in before embarking to fight at the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Shadow_Squadron_briefing.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker briefs Contrail and Shadow Squadron aboard the ''Resolute''.]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clones" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] designated CT-4981<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> was bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve alongside his clone brethren in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clones" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], CT-4981&mdash;nicknamed "Contrail"&mdash;served as a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence">{{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 87-88|The ''Malevolence'' Campaign}}</ref> the Confederacy constructed a new [[Warship/Legends|warship]],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. Commanded by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and armed with twin powerful [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]], the ''Malevolence'' inflicted heavy casualties upon Republic forces. Determined to stop Grievous, Skywalker formed a battle plan and gathered Contrail and the rest of Shadow Squadron aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], for a briefing.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Realizing that [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were no match for the ''Malevolence'', Skywalker planned to use<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> recently acquired [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]]<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref> to slip through the Confederate warship's defenses, strike at its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Grievous. Deducing that Grievous's next target was the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] where a large number of wounded clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were being treated, Skywalker decided to go through the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]], a shortcut that ran through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], in order to arrive there before the ''Malevolence''. Meanwhile, a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] would take a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] around the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] and would join the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|battle]] later.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> Contrail, assuming the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Shadow Eleven" and paired with the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-J8/Legends|R2-J8]],<ref name="Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> then boarded his Y-wing along with his gunner and followed the rest of Shadow Squadron as they left the ''Resolute''. After checking in with Skywalker, the clone [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] followed him&mdash;as well as Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]&mdash;to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

When Contrail and his companions emerged from hyperspace and entered the nebula, they found themselves amidst a flock of giant [[Neebray/Legends|neebray]] mantas native to that region. In order to avoid colliding with them, Skywalker ordered Shadow Squadron to assume single-file [[Bantha formation/Legends|Bantha formation]] and follow his lead. The squadron successfully navigated the nebula, although pilot [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick's]] fighter was damaged in a brush with a manta. As a result of another brush, Contrail's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] was destroyed when his dome was cut off. As soon as Contrail and the rest of the pilots emerged from the nebula and reached the [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|medical station]], the ''Malevolence'' emerged from hyperspace and approached the station, whose patients were being evacuated by [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]]. After Grievous disabled the retreating evacuation [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], Skywalker led Shadow Squadron in an attack on the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} bridge.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

[[File:Shadow_Eleven.png|thumb|right|250px|Contrail at the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]]
However, the warship fired its massive [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], disabling almost half of Skywalker's forces, while more clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] fell to fire from weapon emplacements protecting the bridge. Convinced by Tano and Koon that the direct assault on the bridge would not succeed, Skywalker changed his plans and led Contrail and the surviving members of Shadow Squadron in an attack on the warship's starboard ion cannon, inflicting heavy damage to it. The attack resulted in both weapons exploding when Grievous tried to fire the damaged cannon; the resulting explosion also damaged the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Kenobi's and Yularen's fleet then arrived and chased the crippled warship away from the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical station]], allowing the three Jedi, Contrail, and the remainder of the squadron to land aboard the station to regroup and [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> Eventually, the ''Malevolence'' was destroyed, although Grievous escaped.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Contrail continued to serve with Shadow Squadron throughout the remainder of the war and witnessed the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He was subsequently absorbed into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and continued his piloting career in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

===Imperial service===
{{Quote|You're aware that I'm a clone, sir?''"<br />"''Yes.''"<br />"''Well, twenty years ago, after Shadow Squadron was disbanded, I hit a commanding officer&mdash;a non-clone. When he ordered me to kill my gunner&mdash;who had been wounded in combat, but not mortally&mdash;I refused. And when my commanding officer tried to shoot me for refusing, I broke his jaw. I spent a year in solitary.|Contrail tells Darth Vader about his demotion|<ref name="Vader Adrift" />}}
[[File:Hockaleg_fireworks.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Contrail and TK-813 bear witness to the destruction of the ''Tarkin''.]]
Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Disbanded">"[[Vader Adrift]]" states that [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] was disbanded two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Shadow Squadron was disbanded, but Contrail continued his service as an Imperial pilot, serving under a [[Unidentified Imperial officer (CT-4981)|non-clone officer]]. On one occasion, Contrail's [[Unidentified clone stormtrooper gunner|clone gunner]] was severely&mdash;but not fatally&mdash;wounded. The [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] ordered Contrail to kill the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], but Contrail refused to do so, since the gunner was his friend. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] then attempted to shoot Contrail for insubordination, but the clone fought back and broke the commander's [[Bone/Legends|jaw]]. Contrail was taken into custody and sentenced to a [[16 BBY/Legends|year-long]] [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] in a solitary cell. After he had served his term, Contrail was demoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of a common [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. The clone gunner whose life Contrail had saved survived his wound but was killed [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later during a [[bombing run]]. For the next nineteen years, Contrail loyally served the Empire.<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="ERC" /> he was stationed on the planet [[Hockaleg]], where the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was being constructed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the planet. Placed in charge of the local Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]], Contrail's task was to maintain order among Hockaleg's population, which had been forcefully conscripted to work at [[Hockaleg spaceport|Hockaleg's spaceport]].<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

During one shift at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], shortly after he had cleared a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] for the ''Tarkin'', Contrail was approached by a young trooper designated [[TK-813]], who informed the clone trooper that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader was aboard the ''Tarkin'' at the moment. Ensuring that none of the workers were listening to them, Contrail asked TK-813 how he had discovered that, and the young trooper replied that trooper [[TK-529]] had heard that information at the troopers' [[Hockaleg Imperial headquarters|headquarters]]. Contrail believed that the laborers were not fond of the Empire and suspected that there could even be [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] among them, who could exploit the information regarding Vader's presence. As such, Contrail promised the young trooper to take him and TK-529 to the headquarters at the next rotation in order to remind them about maintaining protocol and distributing information on a need-to-know basis. At that moment, however, Contrail witnessed an explosion in the sky; the ''Tarkin'' had been [[Infiltration of the Tarkin|destroyed]] by a Rebel Alliance strike team. Without any hesitation, Contrail rushed to a nearby [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and set off into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to search for survivors of the explosion.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

He soon came upon a damaged [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]], the personal starfighter of Darth Vader, who had survived the superweapon's destruction and was drifting in space. Vader signaled Contrail with his fighter's running lights; when the pilot approached the fighter, he saw Vader pointing at his craft's egress hatch. Understanding Vader's intent, Contrail positioned his shuttle as close to the hatch as possible and opened the shuttle's starboard [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Vader then opened the TIE's hatch and drifted through space into the shuttle. After Vader&mdash;who had been known as Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars&mdash;entered the shuttle's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], he recognized the pilot as a former clone trooper and demanded to know why the craft was being piloted by a stormtrooper instead of an Imperial pilot. Contrail told Vader about his service after the Clone Wars and offered to take the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to his personal [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], stationed nearby, but the latter declined. Instead, he ordered Contrail to take him to Hockaleg and leave a [[distress strobe]] at his fighter so that it could be picked up by the ''Executor''{{'s}} crew.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

When they approached the planet, and Contrail tried to receive clearance to land from the spaceport authorities, no one responded on the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Vader ordered him to proceed with the landing anyway, and the two soon emerged from the shuttle at the Hockaleg spaceport. They then heard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and witnessed a stormtrooper running toward them from an alleyway, shooting back at someone. When the trooper, fatally wounded, collapsed at Contrail's feet, the latter recognized him as TK-813. Before dying, TK-813 told Contrail that the laborers had rebelled after the destruction of the ''Tarkin'' and attacked the Imperial headquarters. Vader decided to return to the shuttle, advising Contrail to keep close. As they approached the shuttle, however, the two were attacked by a group of laborers. Ordering Contrail to prepare the shuttle for takeoff, Vader disarmed one group of attackers with the help of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], but he did not notice another group that approached him from behind. Determined to protect his superior, Contrail disobeyed the order and shielded Vader from enemy blaster fire with his own body. As Contrail fell on the ground with mortal wounds, Vader approached him and comforted him in his final moments, commending his piloting skill at the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula. Acknowledging Anakin Skywalker as a good mentor, Contrail died from his wounds. Vader, stirred by his death, proceeded to slaughter the laborers who had attacked them with his [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], not paying attention to their pleas for mercy.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If you were to serve under my command, would you ever disobey an order?''"<br />"''Yes, sir, but only if it helped you to live longer.|Darth Vader and Contrail|<ref name="Vader Adrift" />}}
[[File:VaderContrailDeath-SWISE2012.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Contrail dies in Darth Vader's arms on Hockaleg.]]
Like all clone troopers, Contrail stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clones" /> and, like his progenitor, Jango Fett,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> he had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> Due to the clone troopers' accelerated aging,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Clones" /> Contrail was fairly old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of his death. His hair had become mostly white, and his face was heavily lined with age and covered in scars, although he retained Fett's distinctive gravelly voice and the clone troopers' clipped manner of speech. As the commander of the Hockaleg garrison, Contrail was very strict regarding maintaining proper protocol, and he wanted to rebuke TK-813 and TK-529 for recklessly discussing classified information. He addressed his fellow stormtroopers by their designations and was confused when TK-813 called TK-529 by his nickname, "Grimes." The clone trooper was cautious, believing that the laborers on Hockaleg did not like the Empire and that there were Rebel spies among them. The former observation proved true when the people rebelled after the destruction of the ''Tarkin''. Contrail was decisive and quick-thinking, embarking on the search for survivors immediately after the superweapon's explosion.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

A veteran [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who spent his entire life in service to the Republic and the Empire, Contrail still displayed a streak of independence. He was unwilling to kill a fellow clone and attacked the officer who ordered him to do so. Although the clone gunner whom Contrail had saved died shortly thereafter, essentially rendering Contrail's rebellion meaningless, the clone trooper did not regret his decision, feeling glad that it had helped the gunner live a little longer and realizing that everyone was destined to die someday. Although Vader was used to instilling fear in his subordinates, he did not [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] any fear in Contrail, nor did he feel the need to try to make the clone trooper afraid of him. On the contrary, the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] was impressed by Contrail's strong composure and felt reliability and loyalty exuding from the clone through the Force. When Vader asked Contrail if he would ever disobey his orders, the clone admitted that he would if it helped save Vader's life. Contrail later did exactly that when he found himself feeling unable to leave Vader alone near the shuttle and ended up saving his life. When Vader commended his flying at the Kaliida Nebula, calling him by his nickname despite the fact that the clone had only used his numerical designation in Vader's presence, Contrail was not surprised. With his last words, he said that he considered Anakin Skywalker a good teacher.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|And you are an experienced pilot.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|Darth Vader and Contrail|<ref name="Vader Adrift" />}}
Contrail was an expert pilot, capable of handling different vehicles, from the Y-wing starfighter to a boxy Imperial shuttle.<ref name="Vader Adrift" /> His skill allowed him to survive the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> and was noted by Darth Vader, who was an adept pilot himself. When Contrail maneuvered the shuttle in position to take Vader aboard, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord took notice of his expertly handled moves.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

==Equipment==
During the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula, Contrail wore a pilot's variant of [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], with the [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Republic's crest]] printed on his [[Armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> When he was stationed on Hockaleg, he was clad in standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], complete with a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] and a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], and was armed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Vader Adrift" />

==Behind the scenes==
Contrail first appeared in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which first aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]], although an image of him from the episode was featured prior to that in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''. Identified only as "Shadow Eleven," he, like all clone troopers in the show, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="SoM ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> In [[August]] [[2011]], "Shadow Eleven" was identified as Contrail in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''.<ref name="Incredible Vehicles" /> Shortly thereafter, he appeared as a main character in ''[[Vader Adrift]]'', a short story written by [[Ryder Windham]] and illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]]. Published in [[Star Wars Insider Special Edition 2012|''Star Wars Insider'' Special Edition 2012]] in November 2011, the short story provided Contrail with his clone designation of CT-4981 and featured his death on Hockaleg.<ref name="Vader Adrift" />
